description: Open browser URLs when requested, inspect sessions, inspect open apps/windows, bring apps to the main visible screen, and run approved desktop actions for any app. Use computer.apps/windows/show_app/select_window before scoped screenshots or actions. For visual clicks, use the zoom ladder: full or selected-window screenshot, crop/zoom the likely region with source=latest when the target is small, then click with normalized_x/normalized_y relative to that attached crop. source=latest crops from the last full/selected-window screenshot; use source=current_crop only when intentionally cropping the current crop again. Take a fresh full/selected-window screenshot before unrelated actions so old zoom coordinates are not reused. Hidden-window/background control is disabled.

config.name: browser_computer
config.summary: Approved browser and all-app visible-screen computer actions. Use computer.context/apps/windows before screenshots/clicks, computer.show_app to bring Vivaldi/Chrome/etc. to the main screen, computer.select_window for visible windows, then use full/selected-window screenshot -> source=latest crop/zoom for small targets -> coordinate_space=normalized_1000 with normalized_x/normalized_y on the attached crop. source=latest crops from the last full/selected-window screenshot; use source=current_crop only for an intentional crop-of-crop. Take a fresh screenshot before unrelated actions so a stale zoom does not trap the model. Use computer.type for text input. Hidden-window/background DOM entry is disabled.

action.description: Use browser.open_url/session for browser navigation and inspection. Use computer.context/apps/windows/monitors to inspect open apps, visible windows, and displays. Use computer.select_monitor with monitor_id/display_id/monitor_index to aim desktop screenshots/actions at a specific screen, computer.show_app to bring an app to a visible screen, computer.select_window to target a visible window, and computer.screenshot before physical actions. For small or ambiguous image targets, do not click from the full screenshot; request computer.screenshot with crop/zoom/detail first, usually payload.source=latest, then click using payload.normalized_x and payload.normalized_y relative to that attached crop. source=latest crops from the last full/selected-window screenshot; use source=current_crop only for an intentional crop-of-crop. After a zoomed/cropped view, request a fresh screenshot before unrelated actions. payload.point:[y,x] is accepted only for legacy compatibility. computer.click/move/drag default to the virtual AI cursor and marker previews; set payload.physical=true only after explicit approval to operate the visible UI.

payload.description: Action payload. For visual coordinates, prefer normalized_x and normalized_y plus coordinate_space=normalized_1000. Legacy point:[y,x] and normalized_point are accepted for compatibility only. Use monitor_id/display_id/monitor_index with computer.select_monitor or computer.screenshot target=monitor to choose a display. Use source=latest plus crop, zoom, normalized_box, crop_x/crop_y/crop_width/crop_height, or detail on computer.screenshot to inspect small targets. source=latest crops from the last full/selected-window screenshot; use source=current_crop only when intentionally cropping the current crop again. Cropped/zoomed screenshots become the new attached-image coordinate reference; take a fresh screenshot before unrelated actions. Use app/name with computer.show_app, app/title/title_contains with computer.select_window, text with computer.type, and physical=true only when a click/move/drag should operate the visible UI instead of the default virtual marker preview.
